notes.title: About the future (1.0 and more)
notes.notes: [p]Hey there everyone,[/p][p]in this post I will share some info about the 1.0 release and the future[/p][p][/p][p]The game will release into 1.0 in the coming weeks, there is no exact date so far but it will be soon[/p][p][/p][p][b]What does 1.0 include?[/b][/p][p]- functional cloud saving[/p][p]- balance adjustments to towers and enemies[/p][p]- some minor fixes to maps[/p][p]- working idle maps without performance issues[/p][p][/p][p][b]What is in the game so far?[/b][/p][p]- 24 towers[/p][p]- enemies with unique abilities and defensive stats[/p][p]- achievements (a full run takes around 2.5 to 3 hours)[/p][p]- a nearly infinite upgrade system[/p][p]- ...[/p][p][/p][p][b]Of course the game will be on sale when it releases![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What is gonna happen after 1.0?[/b][/p][p]Depending on feedback, player requests and other factors the development will continue[/p][p]In case of no interest into the game, development will pause [b]BUT NOT END[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]That is everything for today[/p][p]Have a nice week[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers[/p]
